root_cause.text: In `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c:ice_set_ringparam()`, the error-handling goto chain was incomplete and inconsistent with allocation order, so failures after allocating `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings` but before successful Rx setup skipped freeing `xdp_rings` and sometimes `tx_rings`, causing leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the `!rx_rings` failure path from `goto done;` to `goto free_xdp;`, changes the per-Rx-ring setup failure path from `goto free_tx;` to `goto free_xdp;`, and adds a new `free_xdp` label that frees all `xdp_rings` before falling through to `free_tx`; the CVE/commit message explicitly states these prior paths leaked `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings` or leaked `xdp_rings` alone.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c:ice_set_ringparam()`, the error-handling goto chain was incomplete and inconsistent with allocation order, so failures after allocating `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings` but before successful Rx setup skipped freeing `xdp_rings` and sometimes `tx_rings`, causing leaks.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes the `!rx_rings` failure path from `goto done;` to `goto free_xdp;`, changes the per-Rx-ring setup failure path from `goto free_tx;` to `goto free_xdp;`, and adds a new `free_xdp` label that frees all `xdp_rings` before falling through to `free_tx`; the CVE/commit message explicitly states these prior paths leaked `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings` or leaked `xdp_rings` alone.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the rx_rings allocation failure path to release previously allocated XDP resources before returning an error.
intent_record.what: The error-handling branch after a failed allocation of rx_rings was changed from `goto done;` to `goto free_xdp;` in `ice_set_ringparam()`.
intent_record.how: When allocation of `rx_rings` fails, execution now jumps to a cleanup path that frees previously allocated XDP-related resources before exiting, instead of skipping that cleanup and going directly to the final exit path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the `ice_set_ringparam()` ENOMEM error path to jump to the XDP cleanup label so all allocated resources are freed correctly.
intent_record.what: The error-handling jump target in `ice_set_ringparam()` was changed from `goto free_tx;` to `goto free_xdp;` in the `-ENOMEM` path after `kfree(rx_rings);`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this changes which cleanup block executes when allocation/setup in this branch fails, ensuring XDP-related resources are also released before returning `-ENOMEM` instead of skipping that cleanup path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing error-path cleanup for allocated XDP Tx rings to prevent resource leaks during ring parameter reconfiguration failures.
intent_record.what: A new error-handling label `free_xdp:` was added before the existing `free_tx:` cleanup block, and it conditionally frees allocated XDP Tx rings by iterating over `xdp_rings` with `ice_for_each_xdp_txq(vsi, i)`, calling `ice_free_tx_ring(&xdp_rings[i])` for each entry, then freeing the `xdp_rings` array with `kfree(xdp_rings)`.
intent_record.how: On error paths that jump to `free_xdp`, the function now releases previously allocated XDP ring resources before continuing cleanup, preventing leaked XDP Tx ring allocations when setup fails partway through.

grouping_result.intent: Add missing error-path cleanup for allocated XDP Tx rings to prevent resource leaks during ring parameter reconfiguration failures.

consistency_review.core_intent: Ensure ring parameter reconfiguration error paths correctly clean up allocated XDP and related ring resources to prevent leaks on allocation failure.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly fix the incomplete error-handling cleanup in ice_set_ringparam() by freeing previously allocated XDP and related ring resources on allocation/setup failure paths, matching the described leak root cause.

candidates.rationale: When rx_rings allocation fails after tx_rings and xdp_rings were already allocated, jumping directly to done skips intermediate cleanup labels, leaking previously allocated resources.
This error-path jump is incomplete because it frees only Tx-related allocations and bypasses required XDP cleanup, causing xdp_rings to leak on later Rx setup failures.
The cleanup chain rooted at free_tx was inconsistent with allocation order and lacked XDP cleanup before the fix, making jumps to this label insufficient and directly enabling leaks.

vuln_statements.explanation: On the rx_rings allocation failure path, this jump bypassed the intermediate cleanup labels needed to free earlier allocations, specifically xdp_rings and potentially tx_rings, matching the root cause of an incomplete goto cleanup chain.

This error-path jump targeted a cleanup label that did not include XDP cleanup in the pre-fix code, so failures after xdp_rings allocation but before successful Rx setup leaked xdp_rings due to inconsistent cleanup ordering.

The pre-fix cleanup label itself was part of the vulnerable control-flow structure because it represented a cleanup chain endpoint that omitted required xdp_rings release, making jumps to it insufficient after prior XDP allocation.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit fcea6f3da546b93050f3534aadea7bd96c1d7349
Author: Anirudh Venkataramanan <anirudh.venkataramanan@intel.com>
Date:   Tue Mar 20 07:58:16 2018 -0700

    ice: Add stats and ethtool support
    
    This patch implements a watchdog task to get packet statistics from
    the device.
    
    This patch also adds support for the following ethtool operations:
    
    ethtool devname
    ethtool -s devname [msglvl N] [msglevel type on|off]
    ethtool -g|--show-ring devname
    ethtool -G|--set-
bic_trace_step.reason: The shown function body for `ice_set_ringparam()` is sufficient to evaluate the specific leak pattern described. However, this commit version does not yet contain the vulnerable construct from the root cause because it only allocates `tx_rings` and `rx_rings`; there is no allocation or handling of `xdp_rings` anywhere in this function. The relevant error paths are: after Tx allocation/setup, failures in Rx setup go to `free_tx:` via `goto free_tx;`, and that label frees all allocated Tx rings with `ice_free_tx_ring(&tx_rings[i]);` and `devm_kfree(&pf->pdev->dev, tx_rings);`. Likewise, Rx failures free already-created Rx rings in the `rx_unwind` block before jumping to `free_tx`. Since the root cause specifically requires failures after allocating both `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings` where the goto chain skips freeing `xdp_rings` (and sometimes `tx_rings`), that condition does not exist in this version because `xdp_rings` is completely absent. At the same time, the later fix is also not present here because there is no expanded cleanup logic for XDP-related allocations; this is simply an earlier implementation predating the vulnerable XDP allocation/error-handling path.
